snippet.title: Jennifer Wilde Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
In 1921, young French artist Jennifer Chevalier becomes embroiled in death, espionage and revolution, assisted by the ghost of Oscar Wilde. A hand-drawn Point & Click adventure with a unique comic book inventory design.

Steam (PC): https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466350/Jennifer_Wilde_Unlikely_Revolutionaries/
Switch Europe: https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Jennifer-Wilde-Unlikely-Revolutionaries-2747385.html
Switch Americas: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/jennifer-wilde-unlikely-revolutionaries-switch
Epic Games Store (PC): https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/jennifer-wilde-unlikely-revolutionaries-7eda5e
